method.camera_correction: subtract per-camera median within each source/filter series
method.binning: median within camera/night, then median across cameras; one point/night
method.permutation_scope: nominal conditional p-values assuming exchangeability of final night bins; camera/season heteroskedasticity has not been calibrated
method.injection_location: raw cached magnitudes, before camera correction and night binning
method.phase_fraction_inference: numerical uniform-phase quadrature with nested-grid convergence; not a binomial sample and no confidence interval

target_source_relationship.interpretation: paired catalog/aperture light curves of the same unresolved host; not independent replications
